main_topics.reason: The user came to learn the preventative options before a neurologist visit and spent most turns comparing them.
The stated goal was to go in prepared, and the conversation ended with a question list to bring.
The user asked about side effects and precautions of the oral option in one exchange.
The user asked over two turns whether insurers require older drugs to be tried first.
The user backed up to ask what the traditional options are and whether they are tried first.
The condition is mentioned only as background to the preventative question.

output.summary: The user has chronic migraine and wanted to understand preventative options before their next neurologist visit. The bot covered injectable and oral CGRP drugs, older oral options, insurance step therapy and a list of questions to bring. The user said it was exactly what they needed and planned to ask about one specific oral drug the bot had described.
